contests.title: Tipton Community School District — Measure A: High school improvement bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Cedar County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the Board of Directors of the
Tipton Community School District in
the County of Cedar, State of Iowa,
be authorized to contract
indebtedness and issue General
Obligation Bonds in an amount not to
exceed $16,100,000 to provide funds
to build, furnish, and equip additions
to the high school, including a secure
entrance, gymnasium, and commons
area; to remodel, repair, improve, and
equip the high school, including
educational and administrative
spaces; and to improve the site,
including parking?

contests.title: George-Little Rock Community School District — Measure NV: School improvement bonds

provenance.sourceOrg: Lyon County Iowa Auditor and Commissioner of Elections
provenance.quote:
Shall the Board of Directors of the
George-Little Rock Community School
District in the Counties of Lyon, Osceola
and Sioux, State of Iowa, be authorized
to contract indebtedness and issue
General Obligation Bonds in an amount
not to exceed $14,950,000 to provide
funds to build, furnish and equip
additions to its Elementary School and
Middle School/High School facilities,
including related remodeling and
improvements; to remodel, repair, and
improve the Elementary School and
Middle School/High School facilities,
including HVAC and bathroom
improvements, and site improvements,
exterior improvements to the Middle
School/High School; to build, furnish,
and equip a new bus barn; and to
remodel, repair, and improve the Middle
School/High School track?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $16.1 million in general-obligation bonds for high school additions, including a secure entrance, gymnasium and commons area; renovations to educational and administrative spaces; and site improvements, including parking.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the high school improvement bonds.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $14.95 million in general-obligation bonds for elementary and middle/high school additions and renovations, including heating and cooling, bathrooms, exterior and site improvements; a new bus barn; and improvements to the middle/high school track.
